caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a standing female figure with brown skin, dressed in a red dress with gold trim, a green sash around the waist, and matching green and gold accents at the neckline and hem. The figure wears a feathered headdress with five large green feathers and a gold band. She is adorned with gold earrings, a necklace, and has long, dark hair flowing down her back. One arm is bent forward, holding a bundle or roll, while the other arm rests at her side. The statue stands barefoot on a rectangular, greenish-brown wooden base with visible dimension lines and is mounted on four black wheels. There is a short, vertically oriented log or post situated behind the figure on the base. The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
